main_text.l: In Centum Distocha Heroica a Generoso
Juuene D. Venceslao M. à Zaltrifel,

l.i: Quem Musa iuuenem tanto amplectitur amore-
Quatus erit quado ingenio par venerit atas?
Nempe admiretur merito quem patria tantum,V-
enceslae, tuum quod BEZA & Iperat & optat.
Vas strata lacrymas diuino carmine fudit-
Cur, age, sic renouans nobis, Iacomote, sonora-
isti similes quod poenas crimina nobis-
Et quem non cura ista coquit, nisi qualis in orbe-
Illa Sion nostro, quam condere tempore capitDei illa prapotens manus,

page.notes: Verse lines are printed as one paragraph per stanza; some Greek words, e.g. "Iperat" and "Gnus", are uncertain. Ornamental rules and small decorative marks between sections are omitted.
